U_FPGA.footprint_note: Only 10x10 mm 0.4 mm-pitch QFN-88 in the local KiCad lib; 88 pads + EP pad '89'. JLC lists GW1N-LV9 QN88 as 'QFN-88_L10.0-W10.0-P0.40-EP6.7'. EP size / pad length NOT checked against Gowin's QN88 package drawing (UNVERIFIED).
sources: Gowin UG105 'GW1N-4 Pinout' v1.8.5E (11/01/2024), cdn.gowinsemi.com.cn/UG105E.pdf, pin list p.10-11 + Power sheet p.15
Gowin UG290 'Programming and Configuration Guide' v2.9.1E (07/31/2026), Table 5-1, Fig 7-1, JTAG pin note

supplies.VCCIO0..3: 1.14-3.6 V -> 3.3 V (all four banks independent in QN88)

U_FPGA.power_pins_check: 17 non-I/O pins {1,2,12,21,22,23,24,43,44,45,46,58,64,65,66,67,78} = exactly the pins absent from apicula's 71-pin QFN88 I/O list.

strapping_autoboot.mode: AUTO BOOT (internal flash) = MODE[2:0]=000 (UG290 Table 5-1). JTAG works regardless of MODE.
strapping_autoboot.MODE0_88: 1k to GND (MODE pins have internal weak pull-ups; UG290 recommends 1k pull-down / 4.7k pull-up)
strapping_autoboot.RECONFIG_N_9: internal weak pull-up; UG290 Fig 7-1: 1k to a push-button to GND (optional). Add 4.7k-10k to 3.3V (recommended, engineering choice). FPGA can also drive it via a spare pin to self-reload.
strapping_autoboot.DONE_10: 4.7k to 3.3V (UG290 Fig 7-1; optional LED). Open-drain, low during config.
strapping_autoboot.TCK_6: 4.7k to GND (UG290: 'TCK needs to connect a 4.7K pull-down resistor on the PCB')
strapping_autoboot.JTAGSEL_N_4: keep JTAG pins dedicated (do not reuse TMS/TCK/TDI/TDO as GPIO); then JTAGSEL_N is irrelevant; 4.7k to 3.3V recommended (engineering choice).

U_FPGA.decoupling_recommendation: UNVERIFIED vs a Gowin schematic guide (not fetched): 100 nF 0402/0603 at each of the 4 VCC, 4 VCCIO and 2 VCCX pins; 10 uF bulk per rail (1.2 V, 3.3 V).

user_io.usable_note: 71 minus JTAG(4), RECONFIG_N, DONE, MODE0/1 (strapped) = 63 freely usable; JTAGSEL_N usable after config -> ~64.

sources: Gowin UG803 'GW1NR-9 Pinout' v1.6.5E (03/14/2025) Power sheet
Gowin UG801 v1.5E pin list p.14-15 (QN88P column)
U_FPGA_alt.caveat: QN88P: VCCIO3 MUST be 1.71-1.89 V (it powers the embedded PSRAM). Bank 3 holds 23 I/O incl. JTAG, so only 48 I/O (banks 1+2) are 3.3 V, JTAG is 1.8 V (CH347F VIO=1.8 V would handle it) and a 1.8 V LDO is needed. This is the Tang Nano 9K chip (best-tested apicula target, needs --vopt family=GW1N-9C).

U_ROM.source: Infineon/Cypress S29GL064N/S29GL032N datasheet Doc 001-98525 Rev *B (2017-05-26) via LCSC C117907: Fig.1 48-pin TSOP (models 03,04), ordering info p.13, Table 8, Table 19
U_ROM.model: '04' = x8/x16, VCC 2.7-3.6 V, bottom boot sector, WP#/ACC=VIL protects bottom two sectors (ordering table). Last digit '0' = packing type 0.
U_ROM.boot_sectors: SA0-SA7 = eight 8 KB (4 Kword) sectors at byte 0x000000-0x00FFFF; SA8.. = 64 KB sectors (Table 8).
U_ROM.nc_pins: none on S29GL064N model 03/04 (A21 pin 13 is NC only on S29GL032N)
U_ROM.byte_mode: BYTE#=VIL: DQ0-DQ7 active, DQ8-DQ14 tri-stated (leave unconnected), DQ15 = A-1 address LSB. Byte address = {A21..A0, A-1} = 23 bits = 8 MB.
U_ROM.commands_x8: unlock AAA/AA, 555/55; program AAA/A0 then PA/PD; sector erase AAA/80, AAA/AA, 555/55, SA/30; ID AAA/90 (Table 19).
U_ROM.notes: WP#/ACC has an internal pull-up (floating = VIH); tie high, since low write-protects SA0/SA1 (GB bank 0). RY/BY# is open-drain: pull-up to 3.3 V (e.g. 10k) if used. No separate VIO pin on model 04.

U_DATA_XCVR.source: TI SCES584A (June 2005, rev. Aug 2005) via LCSC C27643
U_DATA_XCVR.function: OE#=L,DIR=L: B->A; OE#=L,DIR=H: A->B; OE#=H: isolation. DIR and OE# are referenced to VCCA.
U_DATA_XCVR.notes: VCCA=3.3 V (FPGA side), VCCB=5 V (GB side). Datasheet: tie OE# to VCC through a pull-up so outputs stay Hi-Z during power-up/down.

U_ADDR_BUF.source: Nexperia 74LVC245A/74LVCH245A product data sheet Rev.13 (2023-08-08), Table 2 and Table 3
U_ADDR_BUF.function: OE#=L,DIR=L: An=Bn (B->A); OE#=L,DIR=H: Bn=An (A->B); OE#=H: Z. Inputs and 3-state I/O tolerate up to 5.5 V.
U_ADDR_BUF.notes: For GB->FPGA at VCC=3.3 V: put GB lines on B, FPGA on A, DIR=GND. Nexperia numbers A0-A7/B0-B7; TI numbers the same pins A1-A8/B1-B8.

U_ADDR_BUF_bushold.notes: Same pinout as 74LVC245A. Bus-hold is always active (OE/DIR do not disable it); TI says not to add pull resistors with bus-hold. Nexperia 74LVCH245APW (C426764) has only 4 in stock.

U_FRAM.notes: VDD 2.0-3.6 V. The whole address is latched on the CE# falling edge, so CE# must toggle for every access.

U_LDO_3V3.source: Torex XC6206 ETR0305_004b, pin assignment + typical application circuit
U_LDO_3V3.caps: CIN 1.0 uF ceramic, CL 1.0 uF ceramic (typical circuit)
U_LDO_3V3.limits: VIN max 6.0 V operating; 200 mA (3.0 V type)
U_LDO_3V3.notes: The CH347 VCC is 3.3 V only (abs max 4.0 V), so it runs off this rail. The 3.3 V load grows with the bigger FPGA and USB bridge. If the budget goes over about 150 mA, switch to ME6211C33M5G-N (C82942, 500 mA, SOT-23-5, same pinout as the 1.2 V part).

U_LDO_1V2.source: Microne ME6211 datasheet V20, pin assignment ME6211CXXG + electrical table
U_LDO_1V2.caps: CIN = CL = 1 uF (datasheet test conditions); ceramic OK
U_LDO_1V2.limits: VIN max 6.5 V; CE high >= 1.0 V, low <= 0.5 V; ME6211C12 Iout max 300 mA
U_LDO_1V2.notes: Tie CE to VIN or drive it for sequencing.

U_USB_BRIDGE.footprint_note: KiCad EP = pad 29; CH347F calls it pin 0 (GND, optional but recommended). EP size NOT checked (the datasheet has no package drawing): UNVERIFIED.
U_USB_BRIDGE.source: WCH CH347 datasheet V1.4 (Chinese) via LCSC C18221627, sections 3, 4.2, 5.1, 5.2
U_USB_BRIDGE.supply: VCC 3.3 V (abs max 4.0 V), 0.1 uF decoupling. VIO 1.8-3.3 V powers I/O and RST# (3.3 V for GW1N-4). Pins 17/18 are always VCC-level.
U_USB_BRIDGE.clock: 8 MHz crystal on XI/XO with ~22 pF to GND on each pin (datasheet 5.1).
U_USB_BRIDGE.usb: UD+/UD- connect directly to USB D+/D-, no series resistors (1.5k pull-up and termination internal).
U_USB_BRIDGE.mode: No straps. PID 0x55DE gives UART + I2C + SPI + JTAG + SWD at the same time.
U_USB_BRIDGE.openfpgaloader: cable 'ch347_jtag' (src/cable.hpp VID 0x1a86; ch347jtag.cpp accepts PID 0x55DD (CH347T) and 0x55DE (CH347F)), checked 2026-10-02
unverified: Pins 7-12 multi-function names collated from tables 4-2..4-7 (TRST=9, SRST=8 per Table 4-3).

U_USB_BRIDGE_alt.source: WCH CH347 datasheet V1.4, Table 4-8/4-9/4-12, section 5.2
U_USB_BRIDGE_alt.mode3_strap: DTR1 (10) and RTS1 (13) pulled low at reset -> mode 3 = UART1 + JTAG, PID 0x55DD. Both pins have internal pull-ups, so use about 4.7k to GND (value is an engineering choice, not specified).
U_USB_BRIDGE_alt.notes: All I/O run at 3.3 V; there is no VIO pin.

J_USB.source: HRO drawing TYPE-C-31-M-12 (2020-12-08) via LCSC C165948
J_USB.notes: Tie DP1 to DP2 and DN1 to DN2. Put a separate 5.1k pull-down on each of CC1 and CC2 (C23186, Basic, 0603). Leave SBU unconnected. KiCad pad names match the drawing.

U_ESD.source: ST USBLC6-2 Doc ID 11265 Rev 5 (Oct 2011) Fig.1
U_ESD.notes: Cheaper second-source parts with the same pinout are C2687116 (UMW, $0.05) and C2827654 (TECH PUBLIC).

D_OR.notes: Use two of these to OR the cart-edge 5 V and USB VBUS. Expect about 0.3-0.45 V drop at 100-200 mA (typical for a 1 A Schottky; this datasheet was not opened). KiCad Diode_SMD pad 1 = cathode by library convention.

Y_USB.notes: 8 MHz for the CH347. A cheaper option is C544974 (ECEC, 1,912 in stock, $0.23). Load capacitance and the 3225 pad mapping (crystal on pads 1/3, GND on 2/4) are UNVERIFIED for this MPN. Use 22 pF C0G load capacitors (C1653, Basic).

X_CLK.specs: 48 MHz CMOS, VDD 1.8-3.3 V, tolerance ±10/±20 ppm at 25 °C, stability over temperature ±20 ppm (LCSC listing). 15 pF load, 45-55% duty, start-up 3 ms max, current 12 mA max at 3.3 V for 41-54 MHz.
X_CLK.source: YXC 'YSO110TR Wide Voltage' crystal-oscillator datasheet (4 pages, PDF dated 2025-12-30), from LCSC. LCSC serves the same PDF for both C-numbers.

pins.1: Tri-state / OE (enable when high or floating, >=70% VDD; disable <=30% VDD)

X_CLK.footprint_note: KiCad pads: 1 bottom-left, 2 bottom-right, 3 top-right, 4 top-left (landscape). This matches the YXC top view. Pad centres are ±0.825/±0.775 mm vs YXC's recommended ±0.925/±0.725 (0.9 x 0.8 mm pads); the difference is small. Oscillator_SMD_ECS_2520MV-xxx-xx-4Pin_2.5x2.0mm has YXC's exact land geometry but is drawn rotated 90°, with the same counter-clockwise numbering from pin 1, so it also works.
X_CLK.notes: Tie pin 1 to 3.3 V, or drive it from the FPGA. Put 100 nF between VDD and GND (the datasheet requires 0.01-0.1 uF). Route OUT to a GCLK pin on the GW1N-4, e.g. pin 35 IOB20A/GCLKT_4 or pin 11 IOL11A/GCLKT_6 (apicula). ±20 ppm is well inside the UART's ±100 ppm budget.
unverified: The datasheet covers the whole series; it is not specific to either MPN. The pin-out and specs are assumed to apply to both, because LCSC links the same PDF for each.
